scene_meta.participants: Zephyr, Elder Pazuzu, Ishara, Igigi Council, Anunnaki battle-forms
scene_meta.focus: At the onset of the Third Coming (Year 14,000), Zephyr presents probability matrices showing a 0.0001% survival rate in direct combat against Anunnaki battle-forms; despite Elder Pazuzu's insistence on honorable resistance, Zephyr convinces the council to scatter across quantum foam to preserve the Great Work, leaving Pazuzu and his loyalists to make a final stand as Anunnaki forces breach Eridu.
scene_meta.continuity: 3,449 years, 5 months after the aftermath of the Second Coming in scene 015.6 (Year 10,550, Month 7, Day 1); marks the onset of the Third Coming at Year 14,000
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Igigi Council's decision at Eridu during the Third Coming breach—choosing mathematical survival over honorable extinction and scattering across the quantum foam.
